title: Rollout scenario story-mapping and tokenized annotation handoff
creator: Asha Patel
description: Synthesize cross-team feedback from the design review workshop and produce a tight handoff package for engineering and PM. Focus areas: 1) tokenized annotations on cost tiles and rollout status cards so teams can quickly scan per-route token spend; 2) story-mapped rollout journeys (canary, A/B, emergency fallback) with annotated telemetry overlays for the Console inspector; 3) visual contrast pass on compact density mode to meet AA text contrast for small labels. Deliverables: annotated Figma frames, interaction spec for folding/unfolding snapshot cards, microcopy inventory for fallback states, and an accessibility QA checklist.
comments: 2026-02-25 Asha Patel: Kicked off with workshop summary — captured inputs from Eng (latency/data constraints) and PM (SLA messaging). Prioritized tokenized display only for 'High' spend routes to reduce cognitive load.

2026-03-01 Liam O'Connor (Eng): Flagged that tokenization requires a new lightweight telemetry endpoint; suggested a batch-friendly top-k spend signal instead of live per-token count to keep latency impact minimal.

2026-03-03 Marina Lopez (Design): Updated Figma flows to use top-k tokens with hover-to-expand details; added microcopy variants for canary vs emergency fallback states. Shared contrast token tweaks for 12px labels.

2026-03-05 Priya Rao (PM): Approved scope for MVP but asked to preserve ability to toggle full token trace for enterprise customers on Dedicated plans. Requested a note in the handoff to include the toggle as a future enhancement for Dedicated + Private.

2026-03-08 Accessibility review (external): Small labels in compact density still borderline on AA with gray-600; recommend bold 13px or increase contrast. Also suggested focus ring refinements for keyboard nav on folded cards.

2026-03-10 Engineering review (sprint planning): ENG agreed to implement the inspector overlay and token top-k feed in runtime-1.19 branch; asked for a clear fallback state when telemetry is delayed (>2s).
2026-03-12 Marina Lopez: Incorporated accessibility redlines, added QA checklist, and uploaded final handoff package. Ready for handoff meeting with ENG and PM on 2026-03-13.
decisions: Use top-k token spend signal instead of per-token live counts to avoid adding tail latency to the serving runtime.
Annotate only 'High' and 'Medium' spend routes by default; allow opt-in full token trace for Dedicated/Private customers under a toggle.
Compact density mode will increase small label weight to 600 and nudge color to gray-800 to satisfy AA contrast for 13px regular labels.
Fallback microcopy for delayed telemetry: show tertiary state 'Telemetry delayed — details will appear shortly' with retry CTA and link to rollout inspector.
Inspector overlay will include a small heatmap strip for token hotspots and an optional link to the cost drilldown page.
